allowed: (1) a number with digits (decimal or Roman) or Latin letters; (2) a range of two numbers separated by a short hyphen or dash; (3) a list of numbers or  ranges separated by a comma or a semicolon (with an optional space, before or after each separator); (4) words or phrases with or without numbers (e.g., cover; back cover; page 4 of cover; jacket flap; p. 3 of cover)
